_notes: The carts' looks (the user, 2026-11-13: 'go ahead, start with the carts'): the Handcart and Wheelbarrow were built from Unity primitives by AgentScripts/BuildTransport.cs; these replace them, with the cargo that fills them (CargoPile).
Made like the world props: concept image, Hunyuan3D shape + UltraTex texture, Tools/Blender/ingest_generated.py (atlas, LODs, collider, height/moss masks), then BuildTransport.DressLooks in Unity.

wheels: the generated wheels are cut out of the model (ingest_generated.py, 'wheels'), each into its own look '<Asset> A Wheel N' centred on its hub, so Haulable can spin it; their hubs and radii go to <Asset>_Wheels.json for the prefab.
Run: D:\ComfyUI\.venv\Scripts\python.exe Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_gathering.py --group transport [images|3d|ingest|all] [asset ...] (Unity closed for 3d).
UltraTex (FLUX) is a non-commercial licence and Hunyuan3D's licence excludes some territories: re-texture/check before a release.
common: Seen from the side and a little from the front and above, the whole object visible and centred, isolated on a plain light grey background. Empty, nothing in it or on it. Matte, softly lit, no glow, no fog.

looks.prompt: A Viking age wooden hand-pulled cart balanced on a single pair of big wheels, like a rickshaw: just two wheels in total, one on the left and one on the right, under the middle of the bed. An open rectangular bed of weathered pale oak planks with low plank sides, two long straight wooden shafts reaching forward from it, joined at their ends by a crossbar to pull it by, and resting at the front on one short upright wooden leg. The two wheels are big, with eight thick wooden spokes and dark iron tyres. Sturdy, worn, hand-made.
looks.note: 'cart' alone drew a four-wheeled wagon at every seed (8101, 8111-8113); 'like a rickshaw' gave two. No leg was drawn: at rest it tips onto its shafts.

looks.prompt: The wooden body of a Viking age wheelbarrow with its wheel taken off, standing on its two legs: a narrow deep open tray of weathered pale oak planks with sloping sides, resting on two long straight wooden shafts. Behind the tray the shafts run back as two handles; at the front they reach past the tray and end in two empty forked ends with iron-ringed holes for an axle, with nothing between them. Two short straight legs under the back of the tray. No wheel anywhere.
looks.note: Made WITHOUT its wheel: no generated barrow had one usable wheel (8201 sideways and fused to the tray, 8211-8214 at the handles, two wheels, or fused to the tray's sides). The game mounts the Handcart's generated wheel, scaled, between the fork (BuildTransport BarrowLook).

looks.prompt: One full sack of coarse undyed hemp cloth lying on its side, plump with grain, its neck tied off with rough rope, soft folds and a patched corner. Only the sack, no ground under it.

One small closed wooden crate, a cube of rough pale planks with a flat plank lid nailed shut on top so nothing inside can be seen, dark iron bands across the corners. Only the crate, no ground under it.
One small standing wooden keg of dark oak staves with three dark iron hoops and a round wooden lid. Only the keg, no ground under it.

A bundle of four split birch firewood logs lying side by side, tied around the middle with rough rope, white bark on their round sides and pale split wood on the others. Only the bundle, no ground under it.

A small Norse rowing boat, a faering, standing upright: a clinker-built hull of overlapping weathered oak planks fastened with dark iron rivets, pointed at both ends with a gently rising curved stem and stern, one plank seat across the middle, two short wooden pegs on each side of the rim for oars, plank floor boards inside. No oars, no mast, no sail.

A single long wooden oar for a small Norse rowing boat lying flat: a straight round shaft of pale ash wood with a worn hand grip at one end and a long narrow flat blade at the other end. Only the oar.
